name: AP_USER_EXCHANGE_RATES
description: This table holds User type exchange rate when submitting the payment process request for multiple currencies and even multiple functional currencies (because the documents payable can be for multiple ledgers).  The user will know the required user rates if the request is limited to specific currencies for specific ledgers and if the payment date is not in the future.  If the user does not know all these factors, then the payment process request will pause later with a status of Payment Exchange Rates Missing.

columns.name: PPR_USER_EXCHANGE_RATE_ID
columns.description: Payment Process Request User Exchange Rate Identifier

columns.name: LEDGER_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used for accounting and reporting in a ledger. It is often referred as, accounting currency, base currency, or functional currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: User exchange rate that is associated with the payment process request identifier.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency in which a supplier invoice is received.
